scope: New objective closed-bar scalp entry hypotheses; fixed 0.01 lots throughout

rules.definition: Prior N-bar high-low width <= 2 times prior ATR14. Close outside that prior range by 0.1 current ATR; candle body >=60% of range, aligned with EMA20/50.
Low/high exceeds prior N-bar extreme by 0.1 ATR, then closes inside prior range. Rejection wick >=50% of candle range, ADX14<=25; long RSI14<45, short RSI14>55.

At least one prior N close is on the pullback side of EMA10. Current directional body closes beyond all prior N highs/lows, aligned with EMA10/30, rising/falling EMA30 over three bars, ADX14>=20 and last completed 15m EMA20/50 direction.

Parameter/10 is the prior candle true-range multiple of ATR known before that impulse. Prior directional candle RSI reaches <=35 or >=65. Current opposite body closes past 50% of prior real body but before its open.

Close breaks prior N-bar extreme by 0.1 ATR aligned with EMA10/30. A later candle within three bars retests the most recent break level, closes beyond its 0.1 break-ATR buffer in the original direction, and has a directional body. Reject intervening invalidating closes; require same entry-window ID. Never signal a retest on the break candle.

Use previous N-bar mean and sample standard deviation to form +/-2-sigma bands. Current extreme breaches the band, then closes between that band and prior mean with a reversing body >=0.25 ATR. ADX14<=20; long RSI14<45, short RSI14>55.

interpretation: Mechanical research interpretations; price shapes do not identify manipulation intent or guarantee a reversal. No volume/VWAP is fabricated.
unchanged_execution: Inherit both cost profiles, contract/lot assumptions, margin, min-lot skips, next-minute fills, bracket/time exits, stop-first ambiguity, drawdown halt, news and rollover controls from the source execution. Preserve risk ceiling even at fixed 0.01 lots.
selection: Per instrument/profile/lane, training-only eligibility/ranking from the existing scalp function. At least 25 trades, positive net, PF>1.05, DD<10%, no halt or maintenance breach in every training year/cost. Otherwise retain an explicitly unqualified diagnostic fallback. Never choose from 2024 results.
chronology: Save catalog and source hashes first; write a training-only freeze before evaluating any new entry on 2024. Prior known controls can be replayed for parity.
controls: Reproduce all 324 prior fixed-0.01-lot profile/lane/fold/cost accounts with exact metrics, audits, lot statistics and ledger digests.
qualification: Positive net expectancy, PF>1.5, DD<10%, at least 200 distinct completed untouched out-of-sample trades, robust stressed costs and stability, no timing/data failure. Previously reused 2024 and unverified historical broker contracts/costs cannot establish qualification.
